title: Pro$^2$ Agent: Scientific Problem Probing for Autonomous AI R&D
title_zh: Pro$^2$ Agent：面向自主 AI 研发的科学问题探查
abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents can now autonomously conduct AI research by writing code and running experiments. They typically do so by iteratively optimizing a codebase, while ignoring the problem structure behind the task. This formulation is effective on simpler tasks, but on difficult problems it often gets stuck in the wrong solution region because the agent never explicitly represents its understanding of the problem. We introduce Pro$^2$ Agent, which shifts the primary state of autonomous AI research from a codebase state to a Problem State: an explicit structure of what problems prevent success and which solutions are likely to address them. Pro$^2$ Agent initializes the Problem State through comprehensive analysis of available resources and constraints. It then performs targeted research to relate the identified problems to candidate solutions. Through controlled hypothesis testing, the agent updates the importance of a suspected problem or the benefit brought by a candidate solution. On the complete MLE-Bench, Pro$^2$ Agent matches the best reported medal rate (70.7%) under the standard 24-hour budget and reaches 76.0% with a 48-hour budget, the highest medal rate reported on the complete benchmark. It also achieves competitive performance on PostTrainBench. In addition, it produces research notes for each task that make the research process transparent and reusable by human researchers.
abstract_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体已能通过编写代码和运行实验自主开展 AI 研究，但现有方法通常围绕代码库迭代优化，缺少对问题结构的显式建模，因此在复杂任务中容易困在错误的解空间。Pro$^2$ Agent 将自主研发的核心状态从代码库转为问题状态（Problem State），显式记录阻碍任务成功的问题及可能解决这些问题的候选方案。它先分析可用资源与约束，再开展针对性研究，将识别出的问题与候选方案关联起来，并通过受控假设检验更新对问题重要性和方案收益的判断。在完整的 MLE-Bench 上，该方法以 70.7% 的获奖率追平标准 24 小时预算下的已报告最佳成绩，并在 48 小时预算下达到 76.0%，创下该完整基准已报告的最高获奖率。它在 PostTrainBench 上也取得了有竞争力的表现，并为每项任务生成研究笔记，方便人类研究者审查和复用研究过程。
key_points_zh: 核心变化：以 Problem State 取代代码库作为研发迭代的核心状态，显式记录研究瓶颈及其候选解决方案。
研究流程：先分析资源与约束，再用针对性研究和受控实验检验哪些瓶颈重要、哪些方案有效。
完整 MLE-Bench：24 小时预算下获奖率为 70.7%，追平已报告最佳；48 小时下达到 76.0%，为完整基准已报告最高。
在 PostTrainBench 上表现具有竞争力；逐任务生成的研究笔记便于人类研究者审查和复用。
